name: MCIPCB13A
tagline: Configurable Intel Core industrial PC with dual LAN and dual COM
description: MCIPCB13A provides Intel Core platform options, dual Gigabit Ethernet, two DB9 COM ports, eight USB ports, and 12–19V input in a 193.9 x 127 x 57.2 mm enclosure. Memory and storage depend on the processor configuration.

specifications.label: CPU
specifications.value: Optional Intel 4th/5th/6th/7th/8th/10th Gen Core i3/i5/i7 CPU

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: 4th Gen: 1 x DDR3L SODIMM, maximum support 8GB; 6th/7th/8th Gen: 1 x DDR4 SODIMM, maximum support 16GB; 8th/10th Gen: 2 x DDR4 SODIMM, maximum support 32GB

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 4th Gen: 1 x MSATA; 6th/7th/8th/10th Gen: 1 x M.2 2280 (Supports SATA and NVME); 1 x 2.5" HDD/SSD

specifications.label: Expansion
specifications.value: 1 x Mini-PCIe half/full card (with SIM slot, supports 3G/4G, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth); Supports Watchdog, Diskless boot

specifications.label: Environment - Operating
specifications.value: Working Temp: -20°C to +60°C; Storage Temp: -30°C to +70°C; Storage Humidity: 10%~90% @30, non-condensing

specifications.label: Front I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x Power Button; 4 x USB 3.0; 4 x USB 2.0; 2 x DB9 COM (COM1, COM2)

specifications.label: Rear I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x DC Power Input (12V-19V); 2 x GbE RJ45 LAN; 1 x HDMI; 1 x VGA; 1 x Earphone jack, 1 x Microphone; 2 x Antenna connectors (for Wi-Fi/3G/4G)
